set.body:
Per run and combined: c'(X'X)^- c for t contrasts; worst-direction sqrt(lambda_max) of C(X'X)^-C' with orthonormalized rows for F (row-scaling invariant); estimability iff orthogonal to the null space, with reasons (dropped column, aliasing); sparse aliased sets (row-echelon null basis) as weighted equations; fixed-effects combination (common sigma stated) and concatenated-runs information sum_r inv(task covariance block); high-pass cost = variance ratio with vs without the cosine set; nuisance df accounting.
Acceptance: fixtures reproduce the m7b methods critique numbers; invariance tests for F rows (rescale, duplicate, reorder).

Consumer: PLS Neuro native model studio epic (see the PLS Neuro integration ticket that names this id). General capability; no application-specific branches.
PLS Neuro spec: docs/plans/2026-10-02-model-studio-spec.md and docs/design/model-studio/ (branch studio/model-authoring-hillclimb, f8d32f0).
set.title: Contrast diagnostics API: estimability with reasons, aliased sets, efficiency, run combination, high-pass cost
